description:
Pretty-print or minify CSS, SCSS or Less, optionally sorting declarations alphabetically. Sorting is cascade-safe: a shorthand and its longhands (border / border-top, margin / margin-top, font / line-height) keep their original relative order. Minify removes comments and whitespace only; values such as 0px or colours are never rewritten.

Returns: Text: the stylesheet. structuredContent { code, movedDeclarations, warnings[] }.
Example input: {"css":".a{z-index:1;color:red;border-top:1px solid;border:0}","mode":"beautify","syntax":"css","sort":true,"indent":2}
On error, includes hint: Unbalanced braces or an unterminated string or comment are reported as errors.

indent.description: Spaces per indent level when beautifying (0 = tabs).

mode.description: beautify = one declaration per line, minify = smallest output.

sort.description: Sort declarations inside each rule alphabetically (vendor-prefixed copies first, override pairs kept in order).

syntax.description: Input syntax; scss and less also accept // line comments.

name: css_beautify
title: CSS / SCSS / Less beautify, minify and sort
